Harbour council weighs a toll on weekend ferry crossings

By Odile Strachan-Varga

Councillors in Quillport will vote next month on a plan to charge a small toll on weekend ferry crossings to the outer islands, a move officials say would pay for a long-delayed refit of the two oldest boats.

The proposal, drawn up by the harbour committee, would add a flat fee to each crossing on Saturdays and Sundays between April and September, when the boats carry most of their passengers.

Island residents would be exempt, but several shopkeepers on the outer islands said the charge could put off the day visitors they depend on during the summer.
